change_policy: Breaking changes require a new major version and explicit producer AND consumer ACK at pinned commits. Silence is not approval.

positive grant revision and current capability research.control

immutable command identity and actor-scoped idempotency
complete canonical command digest bound to receipt
actual KV ModifyIndex is not Raft term, PG epoch or domain revision
canonical record <=4096 bytes
consistent reads never treat unavailable as missing
same Consul txn checks session/leader index/expected anchor CAS
monotonic revision and offset; fixed scope/generation
local fsync then quorum anchor then fresh guard/TTL before receipt

host keys distinct; no TOFU; no IP-only trust
owner-admitted private inventory and live source/endpoint/key bindings
private key fingerprint assertion alone is not proof of private-key binding

producer strattester; status SEALED; capabilities historical_research only
canonical SHA256 and immutable dataset binding
existing VERIFIED_SYNTHETIC result never relabeled physical/live
stable enrolled node identity, key/certificate binding and generation independent of IP
owner-provisioned real trust anchor outside request and repository; no invented production key/pin

no automatic Tailscale fallback for consensus/storage/commands
no DNS/DHCP/route/firewall/adapter/router mutations
logical coordination schema, not permission to widen existing protected activation schemas
same revision/content hash quorum-confirmed
LAB_SIMULATION only; production credentials/orders forbidden

HA duties independent of worker schedule and UI lifetime
instrument exchange/market/symbol/version fixed
immutable raw separate from normalized partitions
content hashes, source sequence/timestamps and atomic committed checkpoint

replicas count only independently verified physical copies
metadata consensus separate from bulk dataset replication
last verified copy/pinned dependencies protected; quarantine then separately authorized verified delete
use existing Grid ingestion/WAL rather than parallel pipeline
missing source sequence remains unknown, not synthesized

UNKNOWN/DEGRADED/RECOVERING/GAP_DETECTED/UNRECOVERABLE/VERIFIED require evidence
existing global authority, not a second SQLite/job scheduler
resource reservation before placement; data locality and capacity evidence

snapshot then contiguous authenticated events; gaps require resnapshot

shared NAT/IP request quotas are distinct from LAN/application byte buckets
egress mapping must be externally admitted; unknown scope denies new requests
mutable shared grants/cooldowns use existing Consul authority only
persist debit before attempt; uncertain attempt/cancel/expiry does not refund spent quota
429/403/Retry-After/available provider headers follow pinned official policy; never shorten active cooldown
authority loss denies new bulk/API permits except explicitly preallocated conservative capacity
local IPC enforcement is not a second distributed authority
